title: VM provisioning and ./lab VM lifecycle
objective: Make the VM reproducible and controllable from the host: ./lab can provision or connect to the VM per #40, install Docker, transport the workspace, and run VM lifecycle commands idempotently. The host stops running the agent container itself.

acceptance_criteria.text: One documented command/runbook takes a clean host to a working VM (Docker plus compose plugin, repo checkout, agent image) with a CPU-only path that works without a GPU.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Sixth 2026-10-28 non-clean CachyOS retry confirms enabled rootless user service still fails: RootlessKit reports no subuid ranges for mester; image build not reached. User-manager/linger/socket setup is valid. New subid helper validates/repairs exact mappings on each start and fails on overlap; KVM retry pending.

acceptance_criteria.text: ./lab gains VM lifecycle commands (names fixed by #40, for example vm up/status/ssh/down) that are idempotent: re-running does not duplicate VMs, disks or networks.

check_workspace() validation still runs on the host before a path is sent to the VM; /, $HOME, the lab repo without --unsafe-recurse, and sensitive credential directories are refused and never mounted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Self-tests 1-6 pass: check_workspace rejects /, $HOME, sensitive dirs; accepts safe dirs; --unsafe-recurse allows repo

acceptance_criteria.text: The VM publishes no host ports by default; an automated check confirms the agent and workspace services are reachable only on the VM's internal Docker networks.

Model access follows #40: host-side ollama/llamacpp are reachable only through syntactically valid, narrow QEMU guestfwd ports; GPU passthrough is not required, and a CPU-only host starts with the same flow and a clear message.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 2026-10-27: tests/vm.bats verifies narrow cmd:socat guestfwd targets for 11434/8080/3128; extracted QEMU 10.0.13 accepted the generated netdev argument and stayed alive until an intentional timeout. Live model connectivity on the CachyOS KVM host is still required.

acceptance_criteria.text: ./lab stop removes agent containers plus workspace containers, networks and volumes and VM-side state; git status --short in the real checkout is empty afterwards.
./verify-lab.sh passes from a clean clone inside the VM, and the run is recorded on this ticket.

The host no longer runs the agent container; any host-side Docker use is limited to a documented service (for example model servers) if #40 chooses that option. README and docs/01-host-setup.md describe the VM flow and remove dev-container-only instructions.

A10: Full lifecycle test on real KVM host passes end-to-end: base → up → status → ssh → agent test → stop → down. Procedure: 1) Verify host KVM: grep -c svm /proc/cpuinfo > 0; 2) Verify /dev/kvm accessible; 3) ./lab-vm base (downloads image, verifies hash); 4) ./lab-vm up (creates overlay, seed ISO, starts virtiofsd + QEMU); 5) ./lab-vm status (confirms PID, port); 6) ./lab-vm ssh (opens shell, verify /workspace virtiofs mount, docker info); 7) cd /workspace && ./lab --unsafe-recurse; 8) git status --short clean; 9) ./lab-vm stop (graceful shutdown); 10) ./lab-vm down (teardown)

A11: Prereq check auto-detects distro, maps packages correctly, prompts before installing. Procedure: 1) ./lab-vm base with missing deps — detect distro, list missing tools; 2) Display distro-mapped package names; 3) Verify [y/N] prompt, default N; 4) On Arch: verify virtiofsd symlink fallback for /usr/lib/qemu/qemu-virtiofsd; 5) After install, re-run: 'All VM dependencies found. OK'

A12: Idempotent lifecycle — re-running up/status/stop does not duplicate VMs or stale state. Procedure: 1) Run ./lab-vm up twice, no second VM; 2) Run ./lab-vm stop twice, second is no-op; 3) ps aux | grep qemu-system-x86_64 ≤ 1; 4) ps aux | grep virtiofsd ≤ 1
A13: Stale state cleanup — manually killed QEMU, ./lab-vm status detects stale PID, ./lab-vm down cleans sockets/PIDs, no orphaned processes, fresh base+up works

QEMU startup uses a valid end-to-end device configuration: guestfwd destinations use QEMU character-device syntax and host loopback targets, virtiofsd is paired with vhost-user-fs-pci plus shareable guest memory, the `workspace` tag is mounted at /workspace, and an immediate QEMU exit fails fast with the real exit status and qemu.log instead of waiting for the SSH timeout.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 2026-10-28 owner CachyOS log at 7b54d26 proves QEMU KVM boot and SSH after corrected guestfwd/vhost-user-fs/shareable-memory argv. Provisioning then failed on nf_tables; generated mount code has regression coverage, but findmnt /workspace and full device/lifecycle proof remain pending.

acceptance_criteria.text: Clean pinned-Ubuntu provisioning loads guest nf_tables before unprivileged Docker setup and persists it across reboot; Docker proxy/non-overlapping CIDR config exists before first start. No --skip-iptables, disabled firewall or rootful fallback. Failed cloud-init saves provision.log before cleanup and propagates status. Procedure: run the recorded clean CachyOS retry, inspect findmnt, systemctl --user status docker and rootless Docker info; retain failure logs and record outcome.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Sixth retry proves Linger=yes, user@1000 active/Ready, Docker enabled; rootlesskit fails `no subuid ranges found for user 1000 (mester)`. Diagnostics did not print current /etc/subuid,/etc/subgid, so underlying absence/reason unconfirmed. Current change adds exact mapping validation/repair and file/getsubids diagnostics before cleanup. Verify no overlap and rootless API on non-clean retry; persistence remains pending.

Host-Docker mode is retained until integrated VM lifecycle/auth/permissions are proven.

acceptance_criteria.text: Cloud-init done-with-errors remains blocked until diagnosed: launcher prints original status/SSH exit code, requests long status and saves JSON status plus cloud-init schema --system output before cleanup, even when diagnostics themselves fail. No generic exit-2 bypass. Real guest schema warning is identified and corrected before clean up/image build can pass.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 2026-10-28 fourth clean CachyOS run proves schema correction: cloud-init status done, extended_status done, errors=[], recoverable_errors={}, then readiness checks passed and agent image build began. Earlier diagnostic run identified groups.0.mester: [] defect and retained status2. No warning bypass used; original-status/diagnostic and generated-shape regressions pass. Image build is independently blocked on registry auth networking.

acceptance_criteria.text: SSH readiness uses a bounded single-Ed25519 scan without the tee|grep-q pipefail pipeline, records stderr/original failure status, and never writes known_hosts from a failed/partial/wrong-key scan. Record real guest boot/cloud-init versus SSH-ready elapsed times on clean and reused overlays; do not claim overall warm-start improvement from guest boot time alone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/vm.bats verifies bounded Ed25519-only successful scan, complete key write, partial/wrong-key rejection and stderr/status. Fourth clean host run reached SSH on attempt6 (~10s), versus prior reused-overlay run ~2m40 with old probe. Clean timing improved in this observation; warm restart after change still needed, so criterion remains in-progress.

acceptance_criteria.text: Non-interactive guest agent-image builds explicitly load client/auth-helper proxy environment, retain daemon proxy configuration and forward all six upper/lower-case build proxy arguments without baking proxy ENV into the image. Missing profile fails closed; build.log retains output and original pipeline status. Live Docker Hub base pull/auth, RUN package installation and completed agent image must succeed under restrict=on and the approved manifest.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/vm.bats executes actual remote build command under env -i with isolated guest profile/mocked Docker: client env, six args, context exclusions, status37 through tee, missing-profile refusal. Real Docker Hub/image retry pending.
